title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issuing the Provisions on Certain Issues Concerning Legal Supervision over Civil Enforcement Activities
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate

Notice on Issuing the Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Legal Supervision over Civil Execution Activities

Fa Fa [2016] No. 30

Higher People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Military Courts and Military Procuratorates; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region and the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

To promote the law-based execution by people's courts and to regulate the civil execution legal supervision activities of people's procuratorates, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate have jointly formulated the Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Legal Supervision over Civil Execution Activities, in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant legal provisions. The Provisions are hereby issued for your earnest implementation. For problems encountered during implementation, please promptly report them to the Execution Bureau of the Supreme People's Court and the Civil and Administrative Procuratorial Department of the Supreme People's Procuratorate respectively.

November 2, 2016

Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Legal Supervision over Civil Execution Activities

To promote the law-based execution by people's courts and to regulate the civil execution legal supervision activities of people's procuratorates, these Provisions are formulated in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant legal provisions, and in light of the actual work of civil execution by people's courts and civil execution legal supervision by people's procuratorates.

Article 1 People's procuratorates shall exercise legal supervision over civil execution activities in accordance with the law. People's courts shall accept the legal supervision of people's procuratorates in accordance with the law.

Article 2 When handling cases of supervision over civil execution, people's procuratorates shall take facts as the basis and the law as the criterion, adhere to the principles of openness, fairness, justice, and good faith, respect and protect the litigation rights of the parties, and supervise and support people's courts in lawfully exercising their execution powers.

Article 3 People's procuratorates shall exercise legal supervision over the activities of people's courts in executing effective legal documents such as civil judgments, rulings, mediation documents, payment orders, arbitration awards, and notarized creditor's rights documents.

Article 4 Cases of supervision over civil execution activities shall be under the jurisdiction of the people's procuratorate at the same level as the executing people's court.

If a higher-level people's procuratorate deems it truly necessary, it may handle a case of supervision over civil execution that is under the jurisdiction of a lower-level people's procuratorate. If a lower-level people's procuratorate, regarding a case of supervision over civil execution within its jurisdiction, considers that a higher-level people's procuratorate needs to handle it, it may report to the higher-level people's procuratorate for handling.

Article 5 If a party, an interested party, or a person not involved in the case believes that there are illegal circumstances in the civil execution activities of the people's court and applies to the people's procuratorate for supervision, it shall submit an application for supervision, an identity certificate, relevant legal documents, and evidentiary materials. If evidentiary materials are submitted, an inventory of evidence shall be attached.

If the materials submitted for the application for supervision are incomplete, the people's procuratorate shall require the applicant to complete them within a specified period, and shall clearly inform the applicant of all materials to be completed. If the applicant fails to complete them within the specified period, the application for supervision shall be deemed withdrawn.

Article 6 If a party, an interested party, or a person not involved in the case believes that there are illegal circumstances in civil execution activities and applies to the people's procuratorate for supervision, and the law provides that an objection, reconsideration, or lawsuit may be filed, but the party, interested party, or person not involved in the case has not filed an objection, applied for reconsideration, or initiated a lawsuit, the people's procuratorate shall not accept the application, unless there are justifiable reasons.

If a party, an interested party, or a person not involved in the case has already filed an execution objection or applied for reconsideration to the people's court, and during the period when the people's court is reviewing the objection or reconsideration, the party, interested party, or person not involved in the case applies to the people's procuratorate for supervision, the people's procuratorate shall not accept the application, except for applications to supervise the people's court's objection or reconsideration procedures.

Article 7 People's procuratorates shall exercise supervision ex officio over civil execution cases falling under any of the following circumstances:

(1) Those that harm national interests or public interests;
(2) Where the executing officer engaged in illegal acts such as embezzlement, bribery, favoritism and malpractice, or bending the law in execution during the case, and a judicial authority has already filed a case;
(3) Those that have caused significant social impact;
(4) Those that require follow-up supervision.

Article 8 For the needs of handling supervision cases, a people's procuratorate may, in accordance with relevant provisions, requisition the execution case file from the people's court, and the people's court shall cooperate.

If the needs of handling the case can be satisfied by methods such as copying an electronic file, consulting, reproducing, or extracting materials, the case file shall not be requisitioned.

When a people's procuratorate requisitions the case file from a people's court, the office (bureau) of the people's court shall handle the matter and provide it within five days. If it cannot be provided on time due to special circumstances, the people's court shall explain the reasons to the people's procuratorate and provide it promptly once the circumstances are resolved.

For cases that are being handled by the people's court or have been concluded but not yet archived, when a people's procuratorate handles a supervision case for civil execution, it may directly consult, reproduce, copy, or extract case materials at the handling department without requisitioning the case file.

Article 9 For the needs of performing legal supervision duties, a people's procuratorate may investigate and verify relevant circumstances with the parties or persons not involved in the case.

Article 10 If a people's procuratorate believes that a people's court may be derelict in its duties during civil execution activities, it may inquire in writing with the people's court about the relevant circumstances. The people's court shall explain the execution status and reasons of the case, and shall reply in writing to the people's procuratorate within fifteen days.

Article 11 If a people's procuratorate submits a procuratorial suggestion to a people's court regarding civil execution supervision, it shall be subject to the approval of the chief procurator or a decision by the procuratorial committee. A procuratorial suggestion letter shall be prepared, and within fifteen days from the date of the decision, the procuratorial suggestion letter together with the case file shall be transferred to the people's court at the same level.

The procuratorial suggestion letter shall state the facts ascertained by the procuratorial organ, the reasons for supervision, the basis, and the content of the suggestion.

Article 12 A procuratorial suggestion for civil execution supervision submitted by a people's procuratorate shall be docketed and accepted uniformly by the people's court at the same level.

Article 13 After receiving a procuratorial suggestion letter from a people's procuratorate, the people's court shall, within three months, reply in the form of a reply opinion letter to the people's procuratorate regarding its review and handling status, and shall attach relevant legal documents such as rulings and decisions. If an extension is needed due to special circumstances, it may be extended by one month upon approval by the president of the court.

The reply opinion letter shall state the facts ascertained by the people's court, the reply opinion and reasons, and shall be affixed with the court seal. If the procuratorial suggestion is not adopted, reasons shall be stated.

Article 14 If a people's court, after receiving a procuratorial suggestion, fails to reply within the time limit or the handling result is improper, the people's procuratorate that submitted the procuratorial suggestion may, ex officio, refer the matter to a higher-level people's procuratorate to submit a procuratorial suggestion to its corresponding people's court. If the higher-level people's procuratorate considers that follow-up supervision is necessary, it shall submit a procuratorial suggestion to its corresponding people's court. The people's court shall, within three months, present its review and handling opinion and reply to the people's procuratorate in the form of a reply opinion letter. If it considers the opinion of the people's procuratorate to be correct, it shall supervise the lower-level people's court to make corrections promptly.

Article 15 If, during the period when a people's procuratorate is reviewing a case, the parties reach a settlement agreement that does not violate the law, the people's procuratorate shall inform them to submit the settlement agreement to the people's court, which shall handle the matter in accordance with Article 230 of the Civil Procedure Law.

Article 16 For a case where a party, an interested party, or a person not involved in the case applies for supervision, if the people's procuratorate considers that there are no illegal circumstances in the civil execution activities of the people's court, it shall make a decision not to support the application for supervision, prepare a written decision not to support the application for supervision within fifteen days from the date of the decision, send it to the applicant, and carry out work to explain the law and reasoning.

For a case where the people's procuratorate exercises supervision ex officio, if it considers that there are no illegal circumstances in the civil execution activities of the people's court, it shall make a decision to terminate the review.

Article 17 If a people's court considers that the procuratorial supervision act violates the law, it may submit a written suggestion to the people's procuratorate. The people's procuratorate shall make a decision within three months after receiving the written suggestion and reply in writing to the people's court with the handling status. If the people's court has objections to the reply of the people's procuratorate, it may, through its higher-level people's court, raise the matter with the higher-level people's procuratorate. If the higher-level people's procuratorate considers the suggestion of the people's court to be correct, it shall require the lower-level people's procuratorate to make corrections promptly.

Article 18 If a relevant state organ fails to perform its execution obligations or its obligations to assist in execution as determined by an effective legal document in accordance with the law, the people's procuratorate may submit a procuratorial suggestion to the relevant state organ.

Article 19 If, during case handling, the civil procuratorial department of a people's procuratorate discovers that the person subject to execution is suspected of committing the crime of refusing to execute a judgment or ruling and the public security organ has not filed a case for investigation, it shall transfer the matter to the investigation supervision department for handling.

Article 20 People's courts and people's procuratorates shall establish and improve communication and liaison mechanisms, closely cooperate, and mutually support each other to promote the lawful, orderly, and stable development of legal supervision work over civil execution.

Article 21 For the legal supervision exercised by people's procuratorates over the administrative execution activities of people's courts, where the Administrative Procedure Law and relevant judicial interpretations have no provisions, these Provisions shall be applied mutatis mutandis.

Article 22 These Provisions shall come into effect on January 1, 2017.
